library.description: RPC probe, service and offline record contracts.

blocks.text: 把真实 RPC 观察保存为有界事件、累计统计、watch 和独立录制。
Contract 定义纯协议与接口，Host 拥有会话、provider 和调用结算，transport 获取真实载体。Devtools 是借统一 probe 的 flow plugin，只读消费观察，不创建业务连接。timeout、retry 等 feature 则安装在所属 plugin 上，拥有调用策略。
English · 使用指南
工厂创建一个由应用持有的 collector。下面只演示真实录制控制，不伪造业务事件。
输出 `true`、`false`、`1`。采集真实业务时将同一个 tools 与所选 transport 放在 `createRpcHost({ plugins: [tools, transport] })`；完整 Coroutine 示例见使用指南。无需另装一个 probe 转发器。
同一 tools 可安装到多个真实 Host，每个安装有自己的观察寿命，事件进入同一个 collector。每个 Host 内只安装一次同一定义。一个 Host 允许不同 namespace 的 transport；业务仍在 `host.<ns>.*`，Devtools 不增加根调用方法。

Host.close 撤回其观察；应用在所有使用结束后调用 tools.close 或 collector.close。关闭 collector 不关闭业务 Host。query/watch/stats/describe/close 便捷方法直接借用同一个 collector；pause/resume、record、clear、export/import 和 service 使用 tools.collector。

rows: 默认 message、peer、forward；其他物理/信封阶段显式启用
显式内容捕获与同步内容投影
精确方法过滤、确定性采样，0 < sample ≤ 1
主环内容预算，默认 8 MiB
序列游标历史读取 / 首次 next 后观察未来事件
累计合格 message 统计，不随主环淘汰减少
独立有界窗口，stop 后可导出

blocks.text: 仅选择 stages 不会自动捕获内容；capture 必须是 stages 子集。原始 carrier 阶段只来自实际载体的真实观察能力，不能用语义帧推造原始数据。慢 watch 和环淘汰的丢失数应一并读取；主环上限不是进程内存上限。

公开入口只有根包的 devtoolsPlugin、collector/选项类型和错误身份。记录 format 为 migaia-rpc-devtools、version 为 1；使用 collector.exportRecord/importRecord，不持久化或向采集器重新注入导入内容。自定义观察使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`，原始载体部署使用 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`。
collector.service 可由应用在既有 Host 上显式 provide；应用负责授权，capture 与 exposeContent 是独立选择。本包错误 source 为 rpc.devtools，保留原生类型与 cause。更多容量、录制和清理规则见使用指南。
默认包含转发事件。查询或记录有序事件后，可关联 `messageId`、`route` 与调用方可选 `trace`，查看各 host 的 `hop`、`maxHops` 和拒绝原因。既有环在保留事件时复制借用路由；实时 probe 回调仍只借用该数组。
English · 包概览

Contract 提供纯事件/接口契约；Host 拥有业务会话和调用；transport 提供真实载体。Devtools 是 flow plugin，通过统一 probe 的 observe 入口借用真实事件；timeout/retry feature 则拥有调用策略。应用持有 collector，不创建第二个观察连接。一个 Host 可有不同 namespace 的 transport；示例仅使用 coroutine。
此示例另需安装 `@migaia/rpc-plugin-coroutines`。将同一 tools 安装到父子两个真实 Host，watch 首次 next 先订阅未来事件，再发业务。安装 flow plugin 时使用 Host.plugins，而非 transport.features。
业务返回 42；事件数取决于两端实际合格观察，不能把一次业务固定等同于一条事件。默认 message/peer/forward 足够观察这次调用；其他阶段要显式启用，且真实载体必须提供相应事实。
上例明确替换捕获内容。redact 同步运行，异常报告 REDACT_FAILED 并丢弃该内容，不改业务结果。方法过滤为精确匹配；sample 大于 0 且不超过 1，暂停使用 collector.pause。resume 恢复原阶段选择，不复活已关闭采集器。

query.afterSeq 是排他序列游标，使用 page.nextSeq 继续；它包含已扫描但被过滤的行。limit 默认 1000，范围 1–1000。watch 在首次 next 订阅未来事件，不能代替历史 query；每批最多 256 条、最多 64 批待取，batch.dropped 报告丢失。return 只结束自己的 watch，collector.close 让等待的 next 以 CLOSED 拒绝。
主环 maxEvents 默认 10000、maxContentBytes 默认 8388608、maxInterned 默认 65536。watch、record 和 content/detail/error 引用另有归属，不能将主环容量解释为任意对象图的深复制或全局内存预算。query.counters 报告淘汰、内容丢弃、重入丢失、采样与 intern 溢出。
collector.service 是嵌套 provide。授权由应用负责；默认远程读取不公开捕获内容，只有 exposeContent:true 才允许。服务读取排除其实际服务 Host 的观察，避免查询递归；不为观察另外创建业务 Host。
同一时刻只有一个活动录制，stop 消费该句柄。clear 重置主环、统计和计数，保留序列进度及 record/watch 寿命。stats 累计合格 message 事件，主环淘汰不倒减；延迟分位值来自有界直方图插值。
记录头保持 `{ format: 'migaia-rpc-devtools', version: 1 }`。export/import 为纯 NDJSON codec，不持久化、不向当前 collector 注入事件。字节与错误图按记录契约转换，不承诺任意 JS 类实例图无损往返。
先结束自己的 watch 和 recording，再关闭业务 Host，最后关闭应用拥有的 collector。Host 安装只拥有其 emitter 清理，collector.close 不负责关闭业务。同步 emit 的可复用 view 若需保留，消费者必须按公开 probe 契约及时读取或复制字段。

自定义 probe 从 `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe` 导入；SDK 从 `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk` 导入。物理 carrier/protected 阶段依赖实际路径，不用语义消息伪造。诊断失败不得替换原业务结果；错误 source 为 rpc.devtools，包含 INVALID_OPTION、CLOSED、RECORD_ACTIVE/RECORD_NOT_ACTIVE、RECORD_FORMAT_INVALID、REDACT_FAILED、SERVICE_RESULT_INVALID，保留原类型与 cause。
默认包含转发事件。查询或记录有序事件后，可关联 `messageId`、`route` 与调用方可选 `trace`，查看各 host 的 `hop`、`maxHops` 和拒绝原因。既有环在保留事件时复制借用路由；实时 probe 回调仍只借用该数组。
stats 的原始 endpoint/method 统计最多保留 4096 对，独立于事件环和名称表。新组合按首次写入顺序淘汰最早的组合；更新旧组合不刷新顺序。`stats().evictedPairs` 是本次 clear 周期内淘汰的组合数，`clear()` 将它重置为 0。
Retain real RPC observations as bounded events, cumulative statistics, watches, and independent recordings.

Contract defines pure protocol rules and interfaces. Host owns sessions, providers, and call settlement; transports acquire real carriers. Devtools is a flow plugin consuming readonly observation through the canonical probe implementation, without a business connection. Features such as timeout and retry attach to their owning plugin and execute call policies.
中文 · Usage guide
The factory creates a caller-owned collector. This demonstrates actual recording controls without manufacturing business events.

It prints `true`, `false`, and `1`. Observe real work by installing the same tools with a selected transport in `createRpcHost({ plugins: [tools, transport] })`; see the guide for a complete Coroutine example. No additional probe forwarding plugin is needed.

One tools object may be installed on several real Hosts. Each installation has its own observation lifetime and feeds the same collector. Install that definition once per Host. A Host allows transports with distinct namespaces; calls remain under `host.<ns>.*`, without root call methods added by Devtools.

Host.close removes its observation. The application calls tools.close or collector.close after all uses end. Collector closure does not close business Hosts. Convenience query/watch/stats/describe/close methods borrow the same collector. Use tools.collector for pause/resume, record, clear, export/import, and service.

rows: Default message/peer/forward; explicitly enable other physical/envelope stages
Explicit content capture and synchronous content projection
Exact method selection and deterministic sampling, 0 < sample ≤ 1
Sequence-based history / future events from first next
Cumulative eligible message statistics, unaffected by ring eviction
Independent bounded window, exportable after stop

blocks.text: Stages alone do not capture content; capture must be a subset of stages. Raw carrier events require actual carrier observation capability rather than semantic frames relabelled as native data. Read watch/eviction loss alongside events. A main-ring bound is not a process-memory ceiling.

The module root exports devtoolsPlugin, collector/options types, and error identity. Record format is migaia-rpc-devtools version 1. Use collector.exportRecord/importRecord; neither persists data nor reinjects imported events. Custom observation uses `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe`; raw carrier deployment uses `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`.

Applications may explicitly provide collector.service on an existing Host, with their own authorization. Capture and exposeContent are independent settings. Errors use source rpc.devtools while preserving native types and cause. See the usage guide.

Forwarding rows are included by default. Query or record the ordered rows and correlate `messageId`, `route`, and the caller’s optional `trace` to inspect each host’s `hop`, `maxHops`, and refusal reason. The existing ring copies borrowed routes when retaining rows; live probe callbacks still borrow them.
中文 · Overview

Contract provides pure event/interface contracts. Host owns business sessions and calls; transports provide real carriers. Devtools is a flow plugin borrowing real events at the canonical probe observe hook; timeout/retry features execute call policies. The application owns the collector without a second observation connection. A Host may have distinct transport namespaces; this example uses only coroutine.

This example additionally needs `@migaia/rpc-plugin-coroutines`. Install the same tools on two real parent/child Hosts. The watch's first next subscribes to future events before business begins. Flow plugins go in Host.plugins rather than transport.features.

The business call returns 42. Event counts depend on actual eligible observations at both ends, rather than one event per business call. Default message/peer/forward observes this call. Other stages require explicit selection and true facts from the actual carrier.

This explicitly replaces captured content. Redact runs synchronously; failures report REDACT_FAILED and discard that content without changing the business result. Methods match exactly. Sample is greater than zero and at most one; use collector.pause to pause. Resume restores previous stages without reviving a closed collector.

query.afterSeq is an exclusive sequence cursor. Continue from page.nextSeq, which includes scanned rows excluded by filters. Limit defaults to 1000 and ranges from 1–1000. Watch subscribes from first next rather than reading history. Each batch holds at most 256 events, with 64 queued batches; batch.dropped reports loss. Return ends only its watch; collector.close rejects pending next with CLOSED.

Main-ring defaults are maxEvents10000, maxContentBytes8388608, maxInterned65536. Watch, record, and content/detail/error references have separate ownership. Ring capacity does not imply arbitrary graph deep-copying or a process-wide memory bound. query.counters reports eviction, content loss, reentrant loss, sampling, and intern overflow.

collector.service is a nested provide object. Applications own authorization; remote reads hide captured content unless exposeContent:true. Service reads exclude observations of their actual serving Host to avoid query recursion. Observation does not require another business Host.

Only one recording is active at a time, and stop consumes its handle. Clear resets the main ring, statistics, and counters while retaining sequence progress and record/watch lifetime. Stats accumulates eligible message events without subtracting ring eviction; latency quantiles interpolate bounded histogram buckets.

The record header remains `{ format: 'migaia-rpc-devtools', version: 1 }`. Export/import is pure NDJSON encoding, without persistence or reinjecting events. Bytes and error graphs follow the record contract; arbitrary JavaScript class graphs are not promised lossless roundtrip.

End your watches and recording, close business Hosts, then close the caller-owned collector. A Host installation owns only its emitter cleanup; collector.close does not close business Hosts. Consumers retaining a reusable synchronous emit view must read or copy fields according to the public probe contract.

Import custom probes from `@migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe` and deployment SDK from `@migaia/rpc-host/sdk`. Physical carrier/protected stages depend on actual paths, without semantic messages presented as raw data. Diagnostics must not replace business results. Errors use source rpc.devtools, including INVALID_OPTION, CLOSED, RECORD_ACTIVE/RECORD_NOT_ACTIVE, RECORD_FORMAT_INVALID, REDACT_FAILED, SERVICE_RESULT_INVALID, with original native type and cause.

Forwarding rows are included by default. Query or record the ordered rows and correlate `messageId`, `route`, and the caller’s optional `trace` to inspect each host’s `hop`, `maxHops`, and refusal reason. The existing ring copies borrowed routes when retaining rows; live probe callbacks still borrow them.

Raw endpoint/method statistics retain at most 4096 pairs, independently of the event ring and name table. New pairs evict the earliest first insertion; updating an existing pair does not refresh its age. `stats().evictedPairs` reports the number of raw pairs evicted in the current clear epoch; `clear()` resets it to zero.

symbols.name: devtoolsPlugin
symbols.signature: export declare function devtoolsPlugin(options?: IRpcDevtoolsOptions): IDevtoolsPlugin;
symbols.purpose: Install one genuine observe flow plugin backed by the caller-owned collector. Direct query/watch/stats/describe/close methods refer to that same collector.
symbols.core:
IDevtoolsPlugin with one collector plus direct query/watch/stats/describe/close projections; retain the exact installed object.
methods: Exact method path filter supplied by the application; methodless control events remain observable.
No method filter; all method-bearing events are eligible.
sample: Deterministic sampling fraction in the interval greater than zero through one, using sender/message identity rather than random per-stage decisions.
`1`, retaining all eligible identities before retention limits.
capture: Explicit stages whose content may be read. Select names from RpcProbeStageName in @migaia/rpc-host/plugins/probe and keep capture within initially subscribed stages.
No content capture; observation remains metadata-only.
redact: Synchronous callback receiving numeric RpcProbeStage and captured content. Return the retained replacement; never retain the reusable event view. Collector executes it during ingestion, log executes it at the canonical emitter.
redact.stage: Numeric stage from RpcProbeStage supplied by the observing emitter.
redact.content: Captured caller-owned content reference from an explicitly enabled stage.
Replacement content, including undefined to discard it. Synchronous throws discard content and are reported; asynchronous redaction is not awaited.
No redactor; explicitly captured content retains its original reference.
Set it when explicitly captured content contains data that should not be retained or logged. Return a replacement, or `undefined` to discard content. Omitting it retains the captured reference unchanged; a thrown error is reported and that content is dropped.
onError: Synchronous observer receiving an original diagnostic error. Return nothing; observer failures are reported through the host failure channel without changing the RPC operation.
onError.error: Original collector observation failure supplied by its owning component.
No result is used and no asynchronous work is awaited by this callback boundary.
Uses the Core hostRethrowReporter failure channel.
Set this callback when a diagnostic failure should reach the application monitor. It receives collector observation failures without replacing a business result. Omission keeps the documented host reporter for the owning component.
stages: Initial stage names from Core RpcProbeStageName; physical stages require explicit selection and selection alone never enables capture.
`["message", "peer"]`; physical stages are not subscribed.
Logical request, response and control observations.
Connection lifecycle observations.
Envelope observations; explicit opt-in.
Encoded content observations; explicit opt-in.
Frame observations; explicit opt-in.
Protected content observations; explicit opt-in.
Physical carrier observations; explicit opt-in.
Use `message` for logical calls and `peer` for connection lifecycle. Add `envelope`, `encoded`, `frame`, `protected` or `carrier` to inspect those physical processing steps. Omission selects message and peer; choosing a stage never enables content capture by itself.
maxEvents: Main-ring positive safe integer capacity, at most the JavaScript array length limit; newest events evict oldest events.
10000 retained events in the main ring.
maxContentBytes: Nonnegative safe integer budget for content retained by the main query ring; independent recording/watch references and opaque-object sizing are outside this byte total. It is not a process-wide memory ceiling; excess content drops while metadata stays.
8388608 bytes, or eight mebibytes.
maxInterned: Positive safe integer reader name-table bound, at most floor(sqrt(MAX_SAFE_INTEGER)) minus one; overflow uses an explicit marker.
65536 names; ingestion itself retains raw string references.
exposeContent: Allows captured content across the portable service boundary; local query and stopped recordings already use their retained captured content.
false; service responses omit captured content.
Install the original bounded collector directly into real host observation. Same feature object may observe multiple hosts; closing one host withdraws only its observation and never closes the collector.

symbols.name: IDevtoolsPlugin
symbols.signature: export type IDevtoolsPlugin = IRpcFlowPlugin & Readonly<{ collector: IRpcDevtools; }> & Pick<IRpcDevtools, 'query' | 'watch' | 'stats' | 'describe' | 'close'>;
symbols.purpose: Complete flow plugin retaining its collector and the same query, watch, stats, describe and close methods. Collector close does not close observing Hosts.
symbols.core:
collector: Exact original collector; the application owns its final close.
query: Synchronously scans retained events with compiled filters. This is a snapshot rather than a subscription; limits are one through one thousand.
query.input: Optional query options; default cursor zero, limit one thousand and no field filters. Take subsequent afterSeq from the prior page nextSeq.
A page with events, nextSeq and loss counters. Invalid inputs use INVALID_OPTION and closed collectors use CLOSED.
watch: Subscribes from first generator advancement to future filtered events. Batches contain at most 256 events and each watcher retains at most 64 queued batches; overflow is counted rather than blocking RPC.
watch.input: Optional query filters excluding afterSeq and limit; defaults to no filters. Use query separately for retained history.
An async generator of event batches; return wakes a pending local next and releases the watcher without needing Collector.close. Collector close instead wakes pending reads with CLOSED; remote stream cancellation ends its service watcher normally.
stats: Snapshots endpoint/method settlement aggregates independently from query-ring eviction; clear resets them.
